Classify a row into one of the 6 predictor-driven scaler types (plus 0/9/50)

Source: R/compute-predictors.R
predictors_classify_type.Rd

A consequence of the rule structure worth noting explicitly (found while writing this function's tests, not stated outright in the source): types 9 ("Missing info") and 50 ("<50 year-sector N") are overridden by rules 5/6 ("Transformational"/"Expansionist"), not only by the strategic-driver rules 1-4. Rules 5 and 6 only test MFP_gr/gross_profit_gr against 0 (via stata_num(), so a missing L3q4_MFP/L3q4_phys_assets/ L3q4_avg_wage still satisfies their "not top quartile" precondition) - so whenever gross_profit_gr or MFP_gr is itself a known real number, one of 5/6 fires regardless of whether the quartile predictors are missing or small-cell-flagged. Types 9/50 only survive in the final output when both growth measures are themselves unavailable too.

Usage

predictors_classify_type(data)
